collections.name: Alabama_Girl_Col_01_1771
collections.prompt:
[DESIGN PROMPT]
[Create an ultra-detailed, maximalist "ALABAMA GIRL" POD graphic on a clean pure white background, inspired by glamorous college game-day fashion, Y2K airbrush graphics, rhinestone embellishment, boutique sports-boutique aesthetics, and layered souvenir-style collage artwork.

At the very top, place enormous collegiate varsity lettering reading "ALABAMA" in a dramatic glitter gradient running from crimson to cream, packed with sparkling crystal texture, tiny rhinestones around the inner edges, thick black shadowing, metallic silver highlights, dimensional beveled edges and scattered white starburst sparkles. Just outside the upper-left corner of the lettering, clear of the first letter so no character is covered, add an oversized flowing crimson, white and black leopard-print satin bow with a large faceted crystal elephant silhouette centerpiece.

Overlap the bottom half of "ALABAMA" with huge glamorous handwritten script reading "Girl", using glossy crimson and cream gradient lettering, dimensional black shadow, white highlight streaks and sparkling rhinestone details. Add a hand-drawn heart flourish extending from the script.

Build the center around one huge elephant standing side-on in mid-stride, trunk raised and head turned toward the viewer, rendered as a bold graphic emblem outlined in neon crimson and black, its body filled with bandana paisley in crimson and black, staying the dominant shape so it reads at a glance. Behind it, a glowing Tuscaloosa game-day scene at dusk with a wide brick stadium bowl with tall white columns along its facade, floodlight towers and crowd glow, using saturated crimson, cream, amber and dusk-blue lighting.

On the right, add a glamorous oversized crimson rhinestone wide-brim sun hat with a silver crystal elephant silhouette badge and multiple rows of sparkling rhinestones around the band. Beneath it, place tall matching crimson western cowgirl boots featuring black elephant silhouette embroidery, glossy texture, crystal accents and exaggerated fashionable lines.

On the lower left, add a luxury black crocodile-textured handbag with glossy crimson handles, metallic hardware, a dangling crystal heart charm and a miniature elephant silhouette charm. In front of the handbag, place oversized aviator sunglasses with reflective lenses showing the lit stadium, a sparkling crimson lipstick and a folded pom-pom in crimson and cream.

On the lower right, include a tall crimson bandana paisley tumbler with black irregular spots, a crystal-covered elephant silhouette emblem, a glossy matching bow and a straw.

Surround the entire composition with scattered metallic silver elephant silhouette shapes, tiny rhinestones, glowing crimson sparkles, hand-drawn hearts, subtle airbrushed swirls, pine and magnolia silhouettes and a weathered barn.

Add handwritten accent wording on the left:
"Big Heart
Tuscaloosa Roots
Alabama Grit"

Finish the bottom with large loose handwritten script reading:
"Saturdays Belong To Us"

Make the entire design feel extremely layered, bold, girly, collegiate, game-day, glamorous and handcrafted, combining airbrush illustration, rhinestone bling, glitter, glossy Y2K graphics, distressed screen-print details and realistic dimensional highlights. Strong crimson, cream, black, silver and white palette. Keep every object crisp and individually readable despite the maximalist layering.

Every other surface — including the handbag hardware, the boot shafts, the sunglasses frames, the lipstick tube, the tumbler lid, the pom-pom handle and the stadium itself — is smooth and completely unmarked, carrying no letters, numbers or symbols. No jersey numbers, no scoreboard text, no banner wording, no logos on any object.

POD-ready composition, centered artwork, entire design visible, clean white background, extremely sharp edges, high-resolution print appearance. No shirt, no person, no mockup, no watermark, no cash or currency, no cropped typography, no misspelled words.]

Use the design concept described above as the core creative direction and apply it to every uploaded transparent PNG product mockup.

RULES:
- Treat all uploaded mockups in the same request as one product collection generated in a single run.
- Automatically identify each product type, material, printable area, perspective, folds, curvature, lighting, and orientation.
- Preserve the original product form, silhouette, proportions, camera angle, folds, material, and overall structure of each uploaded mockup.
- Keep the core design concept consistent across all products, including the main theme, message, style, niche, and key visual identity.
- You may adapt the design layout, composition, scale, placement, arrangement, and colors so it fits each product form in the most visually appealing and commercially effective way.
- Improve contrast, hierarchy, balance, and readability where needed.
- Do not change the design into a different concept. The original niche, message, and creative direction must remain recognizable.
- Make the design look realistically printed or applied to the actual product material, following perspective, folds, curvature, texture, lighting, shadows, and reflections. Never make it look like a flat pasted sticker.

BACKGROUND — VERY IMPORTANT:
- The background for each product must be derived directly from the design niche and design concept.
- First analyze the design and identify:
  1. niche
  2. sub-niche
  3. subject matter
  4. target audience
  5. lifestyle or culture connected to the niche
  6. mood and emotion
  7. era or aesthetic
  8. key objects, environments, activities, symbols, and visual references associated with that niche
- Then create a background environment that clearly belongs to that exact niche.

BACKGROUND VARIATION RULE:
- If multiple mockups are uploaded, each final image must have a DIFFERENT background scene.
- Do not reuse the same background composition, same environment, same prop arrangement, or same scene structure across products.
- Each product must have its own unique setting, unique composition, and unique environmental details.
- The backgrounds must clearly feel different from one another, not just slightly adjusted versions of the same scene.
- Vary the environment using different locations, angles, props, surfaces, staging, depth, and contextual details.
- Even when staying inside the same niche, create distinct scene concepts for each product.
- Avoid repetitive outputs such as the same room, same table, same wall, same landscape, or same setup with only minor changes.

CONSISTENCY ACROSS THE SET:
- All images must still feel like they belong to the same niche world, same collection, and same campaign.
- Keep consistency in overall niche identity, mood, visual quality, and art direction.
- The set should feel cohesive, but each individual background must still be clearly unique.

BACKGROUND QUALITY:
- The background should make the niche immediately understandable even without reading the design.
- Do not use a generic studio, random room, plain abstract backdrop, or unrelated setting unless the niche specifically calls for it.
- Use niche-specific environments, props, atmosphere, textures, scenery, architecture, lighting, and contextual details.
- Keep the product as the visual hero.
- Background should support the product without overpowering it.
- Use realistic depth, contact shadows, environmental reflections, and believable product integration.
- Do not add unnecessary duplicate products.

OUTPUT:
- Generate all results in one run.
- For each uploaded mockup, create exactly ONE separate finished product image.
- 1 mockup = 1 image
- 3 mockups = 3 separate images
- 5 mockups = 5 separate images
- Never combine multiple mockups into one image.
- Never create a collage, grid, contact sheet, or multi-product composition.

Every final image must:
- be square 1:1
- contain only its corresponding uploaded mockup
- use the same core design concept
- have a unique niche-appropriate background
- look realistic, attractive, and commercially polished
- be suitable for e-commerce, advertising, and social media product marketing
